answer: The warrantless search of the car violated the Fourth Amendment [smith:0]. A contract signed under duress can be voided by the party who was coerced [smith:1]. The defendant was sentenced to ten years [smith:9].

sources.text: The court held that the search of the car, made without a warrant, violated the Fourth Amendment.
The defendant was sentenced to five years in prison on the fraud counts.
Contracts signed under duress are voidable at the option of the party who was coerced.
